messages:
maya: heads up 1: courier left a sunflower bouquet and a small snack box in the lobby for a 4pm visitor (Ethan P.). Reception says visitor stickers are nearly out (only 3 left). Anyone nearby to print a paper badge or handwrite one? :sunflower:
frontdesk: mailroom update 1: sticker rolls low (visitors). we have staff lanyards and spare sticker sheets in the supply closet. can also do handwritten sticky badge. box and bouquet on the left bench.
noah: Ill swing by in 5 and do a quick handwritten badge. Also can grab a pastry from the snack box for reception folks.
jess: FYI row A by the window is empty at 4pm; Quiet Room 3 is booked. quick poll: window desk for Ethan or sofa in lounge? vote with :one: for window desk, :two: for lounge sofa.
katie: :one: window desk please, better for calls.
mailroom-bot: courier log: tracking #SNK-4402 delivered at 15:21. sender: "Bloom & Co.". photo attached to delivery record.
noah: grabbed badge supplies and made a handwritten visitor badge on a sticker sheet. taped to lanyard. left a note: "Ethan P. - 4pm".
maya: thanks @noah! @frontdesk can you add "fragile bouquet" note to the guest instructions and secure flowers in vase?
frontdesk: vase placed and bouquet tied with rubber band. added sticky: FRAGILE + Put on counter. Also printed a temporary door pass on plain paper (kiosk offline).
jess: Poll result: window desk wins (4 votes). @maya can you let Ethan know we'll seat him at window desk A3?
maya: done 1: messaged Ethan and confirmed hes coming in at 4. asked courier to keep route notes. thanks everyone. :raised_hands: (reaction: :sparkles:)
file_notes: casual office logistics: visitor flower delivery, low visitor stickers, handwritten badge workaround, seating poll for visitor
